Hi — Fahad here, AI engineer in Dhaka.

I've been researching premium bakeries in Bangladesh, and Cooper's Bakery caught my attention — custom wedding cakes, pastries, and the kind of artisan positioning that commands premium pricing. In the custom cake business, the biggest leak is usually in enquiry handling — every wedding cake order requires a consultation about design, flavour, servings, and delivery, and right now that's all manual.

Here's what I see: a customer messages your Facebook/Instagram page asking about a wedding cake. Right now, someone manually replies, asks about design preferences, guest count (for serving size), flavour, and delivery date, then provides a quote. During wedding season, that's a lot of manual back-and-forth, and leads go cold when replies are delayed.

I built an AI bakery consultant agent that handles social media enquiries 24/7 — it asks about cake type, servings, flavour preference, design inspiration, and delivery date, then provides instant price ranges and books a consultation with your cake designer. It also handles repeat orders from past customers with automated birthday/anniversary reminders.

Happy to show you a working demo in 15 minutes. No commitment.

Best,
Fahad
